👏🏻👏🏼👏🏽👏🏾👏🏿 Too many people feel trapped by unrealistic expectations that are impossible to achieve. It’s about accepting who you are – and finding the beauty in your imperfections.

Here’s your reminder that you are welcome here and you are always enough, regardless of age, race, or gender.

This is a safe space, and supporting one another means the world to us. Your words matter (both to others and to yourself). Please join us in making social media a kinder place and compliment the person who commented before you below. 🫶

Thoughtfully designed with accessibility in mind. 

Rare Beginnings Eau de Parfum features an ergonomic bottle for effortless dispensing and an intentional twist-to-lock cap for easy travel.

Launching August 7 exclusively @sephora or early on the Sephora mobile app August 6.

Every new beginning tells a different story. 

Create the one that feels like you with two NEW Fragrance Layering Balms for Rare Beginnings Eau de Parfum. Layer Sweet Marshmallow for a creamy, alluring finish or Fruity Pear for a fresh, juicy one.

Mix, match, and layer August 7 exclusively @sephora or early on the Sephora mobile app August 6.

Meet NEW fine fragrance: Rare Beginnings Eau de Parfum.

Inspired by the spirit of new beginnings, our new fine fragrance celebrates the beauty of what’s still ahead with notes of bright pear nectar, lush gardenia and jasmine, and warm vanilla bean.

Experience it August 7 only @sephora or early on the Sephora app August 6.

Experience it August 7 exclusively @sephora or early on the Sephora mobile app August 6.

It’s a Soft Pinch Summer ☀️ 

Just one dot of long-wearing color keeps cheeks naturally sun-kissed from morning to night.

Happy birthday to our Founder @selenagomez 🥳
You constantly remind us that vulnerability is strength, kindness always matters, and that a birthday cake photo is mandatory. We love you, Sel! 💜
__
 
Today, we’re honoring our Founder on her birthday and celebrating the heart behind her work.
 
Selena has always envisioned a world where young people feel seen, supported, and less alone. Through the Rare Impact Fund, that vision has grown into a global movement that has reached more than 3.5 million young people and supported 30 nonprofit organizations working to expand access to youth mental health resources around the world.
 
If you’d like to learn more and are able to, you can support the Rare Impact Fund through the link in our bio. It’s a meaningful way to celebrate the community Selena has inspired and the impact we can continue creating together.
